-- TTEX Talk Scene File: DO NOT EDIT BY HAND
-- Quest #1000 / Scene #6 - Function talkevent4_1
function talkevent4_1()
	SetTransitionType(2)
	SetFinalMusic("")
	HideOriginalObjs(1)
	Phase1()

	LoadMap("town000D.map")
	MoveCamera(363.00, 169.94, 96.64)
	RotCamera(5.94, 1.28, 35.00)

	CreateObject(0, 1481, 385.00, 345.00, 0, 0, FALSE, 1, 28)

	Phase2()
	Phase3()
	Phase4()

	PlayCameraNoWait("tutorial_01_6.cam", 0, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	wait(500)
	OpenTalkScene(3, 6)

	RevPhase4()
	RevPhase3()
	RevPhase2()

	Q.DeleteAllObject()
	RestoreMap()

	RevPhase1()
end

Register(talkevent4_1)
